method: Read-only processing on the source machine. Only allowlisted settings, aggregate sizes, fixed intent labels and usage counters leave the source; no raw prompt, tool payload, transcript path, session ID, key or token exported.

skills.note: Directory discovery and override states only; plugin skills excluded, not actual native prompt token count.

observed_project_configuration.note: Current existing settings/instructions in recorded cwd ancestors; no raw project names, paths, MCP connection settings or permission entries exported. Missing/moved historical working directories cannot be reconstructed.

limitations: Tool calls deduplicated by tool_use id; exact repeats may be justified by file changes, retries or validation.
Tool result sizes are characters, not model tokens; serialization and tool rewrites may differ.
Explicit RTK indicator describes recorded Bash inputs, not every hook rewrite or command execution.
Intent flags are fixed keyword indicators; no exported excerpts or semantic success judgment.
Transcript tool counts and usage requests have different units; no causal quota savings estimate.

status: Observed transcript aggregates; not provider billing, quota, effectiveness or exhaustive project-settings coverage.
